in_marathi.name: Hemapriya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of wealth, happiness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hemapriya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hemapriya is a beautiful Sanskrit name that is derived from the combination of two words, ‘Hema’ and ‘Priya’. ‘Hema’ means wealth or prosperity and ‘Priya’ means beloved or dear. Thus, Hemapriya can be interpreted as the beloved of wealth or the goddess of wealth and happiness.
